name: lookbk-skills
description: Free visual agent skills from Lookbk (lookbk.dev): videos, slides, images and web pages your agent renders on your machine.

plugins.name: lookbk
plugins.description: All seven free Lookbk skills in one plugin: two videos, a slide deck, link-preview images, an architecture diagram and two landing pages.

plugins.name: kinetic-title-drop
plugins.description: A 6-second 1080p kinetic-type title video (MP4) from three short lines and three colours. Only this skill; skip it if you installed lookbk.

plugins.name: pixel-quest-promo
plugins.description: A 20-second 1080p 8-bit promo video (MP4): a pixel hero runs one stage per feature on a 120 BPM grid. Only this skill; skip it if you installed lookbk.

plugins.name: swiss-grid-deck
plugins.description: A Swiss-grid slide deck from your notes: browser deck, PDF and editable PPTX with speaker notes. Only this skill; skip it if you installed lookbk.

plugins.name: editorial-og-card
plugins.description: 1200x630 link-preview images (PNG) for every post, with the meta tags wired up. Only this skill; skip it if you installed lookbk.

plugins.name: blueprint-architecture
plugins.description: A blueprint-style system architecture diagram from a description or a repository, as HTML, SVG and PNG. Only this skill; skip it if you installed lookbk.

plugins.name: mono-editorial-landing
plugins.description: A black-and-white editorial landing page drafted from your README, with a working waitlist form. Only this skill; skip it if you installed lookbk.

plugins.name: waitlist-glow
plugins.description: A one-screen waitlist page with a breathing glow and a sign-up form tested end to end. Only this skill; skip it if you installed lookbk.
